description: ResearchOS governance roles. A session is one Arena.ai chat, which the platform binds to one branch. Roles are declared per session and enforced by scripts/researchos_guard.py: a commit must carry Session-Id and Session-Role trailers, the session must exist in state/sessions.jsonl, the session branch must match the commit branch, and every changed path must be allowed for that role.

governance_stages.propose: A proposal must exist (pending_review or approved) and be referenced by a Governance-Proposal trailer. This is what a feature branch does.
governance_stages.land: The proposal must be approved by a different session. This is what the merge to main requires.

bootstrap.description: One-time installation of the governance harness. Capped at a single session by the validator; every bootstrap commit is flagged for post-hoc independent review. At 'land' stage (merge to main), bootstrap must still present an approved Governance-Proposal from a different session — the without-proposal exemption applies only to 'propose'.

proposer.description: Explores sources, records evidence, drafts claims and hypotheses, writes proposals, and implements research code and benchmark artifacts.

verifier.description: Independently re-executes the verification suite and records reviews. Must not modify the artifacts it is reviewing, the validator, the schemas, the policy, the tests, or CI.

approver.description: Reads reviews and records a decision. May not write proposals, claims, evidence, or reviews, and may not touch code, schemas, tests, or CI.

integrator.description: Synthesises reviewed and approved material into reports. Cannot create or promote claims and cannot approve.

review.description: A review must be written by a session that did not propose the change.

approval.description: An approval must be written by a session that neither proposed the change nor reviewed it.

claim_promotion.description: A claim created after the governance baseline may only be 'supported' if it is backed by an approved proposal or by a passing verification written by a different session.
